technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish RSI and MACD offset by price below 50-day moving averages and bearish cloud positioning; moderate confluence but lacks strong trend confirmation.

fundamental.summary: ADSK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) and bearish AAII sentiment (50.4%) create contrarian buy conditions, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, rising USD, flat yield curve) combined with imminent earnings binary event create elevated risk environment for ADSK.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI, MACD, and Parabolic SAR show bullish momentum with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 184.94.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 7 days, price below both 50-day moving averages, bearish Ichimoku cloud structure, crisis-level VIX, and zero fundamental/institutional support create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI and MACD show bullish momentum with price at support, and extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian opportunity. However, imminent earnings binary event within 7 days combined with zero fundamental conviction and crisis macro conditions make risk-reward unacceptable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 7 days presents binary volatility risk that could gap through support; macro headwinds (crisis VIX, rising USD) amplify downside exposure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite technical bullish signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ADSK with 17 other IT positions (9.7% sector concentration); adding to existing position during earnings window and high sector exposure violates concentration and earnings proximity rules.
